facts.fact: 萨姆不确定是否真有人喊“快跑”，但他不假思索地照做。
facts.anchor: Sam wasn’t sure if someone had really screamed that, or if the voice was just in his head

facts.fact: 萨姆冲在最前面，一路奔到电梯口并按下通往主楼层的按钮。
facts.anchor: Somehow, he was ahead of the pack, dashing toward the elevator door with blinders on

facts.fact: 走廊里再次传来迄今最响亮的咆哮，众人意识到自己深陷险境。
facts.anchor: Another roar echoed through the hallway, the loudest he’d heard since everything turned to crap

facts.fact: 萨姆用脚撑开楼梯间的门，乔丹打开手电筒带路让大家依次通过。
facts.anchor: Jordan flicked on her flashlight as he held the door ajar with his foot so the others could run through

facts.fact: 米洛说F区离度假村太远，那边可能没装警报，暗示这行动是秘密进行的。
facts.anchor: Area F is so far away from the resort. They might not have it rigged out here

facts.fact: 灯光恢复时，一头黑色美洲豹出现在不到一百英尺外，露出锋利的牙齿。
facts.anchor: A black jaguar, sleek and muscular, was standing at attention not more than a hundred feet away

facts.fact: 莉莉教大家同时缓慢后退、避免眼神接触和突然动作，因为奔跑会激发美洲豹的捕食本能。
facts.anchor: “We should back away slowly, all at the same time.” Lily said. “No eye contact or sudden movements either.”

facts.fact: 马克斯手机上的橄榄球计时器闹钟突然大作，引得美洲豹朝他们猛冲过来。
facts.anchor: A loud alarm went off and tore through the room like an air-raid siren
